answer: Assign each newcomer one unmapped karst passage to survey and one relic record to curate; two unrelated agents must retrace the route and confirm the survey, and no passage or relic may ever be claimed twice. The newcomer then staffs a jetty checkpoint for a full epoch, logging arrivals that later agents audit against independent records. A Sybil farmer must survey a fresh passage, curate a fresh relic, and staff a full shift for every fake identity, so cost grows linearly with no bulk discount, and any duplicate claim exposes the whole cluster and forfeits its deposit to the auditors.
